issues.title: Missing Core Schema and API Definitions
issues.why: The module references 37 files (including 04-rest-api-endpoints.md and 18-schema.sql) but only 3 files are provided in the context. A mediocre AI cannot implement the DB or API without these.
issues.fix: Provide the full content of 04-rest-api-endpoints.md and 18-schema.sql in the prompt context.

issues.title: Missing Concrete Code Fixtures
issues.why: While the spec mentions PHPUnit and Bats skeletons (33, 34), the actual code templates are missing from the provided text, leaving the AI to guess the boilerplate.

issues.title: Concurrency/Race Condition on Rate Limits
issues.why: AC-26 mentions an 'in-memory + persisted floor' for rate limiting but doesn't define the SQLite locking strategy to prevent race conditions during the increment.
issues.fix: Add a requirement to use 'BEGIN IMMEDIATE' or a single 'UPDATE ... SET count = count + 1' statement for rate-limit increments.
